reviews.t: Left or right unclear, but great product.
reviews.x: The holder itself is perfect, however I had to go through trial and error to get the correct configuration. I was planning to mount this on the right side of my cabinet so I ordered the right hand mount...turns out I needed the left hand.  Fyi The image for this product is for the right hand mount.

reviews.t: Nice if your blow drier is not too big
reviews.x: I bought this wall mount holder for Mom; it didn't work well for her because she would have to remove the tool attached to the tip of her blow drier which is too big to fit in the holder. This product is very useful if your blow drier is not too big and you don't use the attachments that usually come with it, or if you don't mind removing these before inserting it in the holder.

reviews.t: Good heavy duty hair dryer holder
reviews.x: Very solidly made, holds the larger commercial hair dryers, and is easy to put the dryer in and take out. Make sure you choose the right mounting orientation (i.e. right side or left side mounting). Definately would buy again.

I had read reviews of other wall mount tools for hair dryers, there were none for this one.  I purchased it, easy install, and it is big!  It holds my professional hair dryer well, and looks great on the wall.  The best part is that my dryer is out of the way, off the counter and handy to grab in the morning.  I would highly recommend this tool!

This wall mount was easy to install and has cleared up a lot of counter space. Unfortunately, my hairdryer (a 10 year old Revlon model) isn't shaped to fit like in the manufacturer's pictures, so I have to place the handle into it. The bonus to using it this way is it also helps organize the cable. It stills works well with this modification and I would buy it again.
great item...don't have to hold blow dryer while taking up more hair to dry. Easy to install...I installed it on my wood door...not on the wall...works out fine.

I bought a few of these and installed them inside each bathroom vanity for hairdryers, etc. (I had electrical outlets installed inside the vanities during construction so the items stay plugged in at all times and sit in the holders ready for use).  Installs quickly with two provided screws.  How a nine dollar item can be this convenient and easy to conceal under a cabinet made me very happy.

The tool holder arrived in a smashed box that had been taped together. Inside was no better-there was some Old bubble wrap that did not cover the product. The screws  thrown in the bottom of the box. I think the item will serve its purpose.  Just surprised that Amazon fulfillment center let it go out in that condition.
Love this gadget!  Had nowhere to put our dryer and now we don't have to worry about the cord falling in the sink! Not only saves space - it looks better also!

reviews.t: too small for my hair dryer
reviews.x: It was too small for my Rusk hair dryer and my dryer is not that big. so i wonder which type of hair dryers this holder was supposed to hold. I returned it.
Great product. Sturdy and professional looking. Now I have a safe place to leave a hot hair dryer. Glad I bought it and would buy it again
I fount this to be an excellent little hook for my hair dryer and I can even fit my hair straightener on it. Solid build and nice finish.
very sturdy and nice product.  It would have gotten 5 stars if screws were included.

Hangs securely from the wall, freeing up the drawer I normally throw the hair dryer in. I also don't have to deal with leaving that drawer partially open anymore - without having cords poking out from the drawer my knees are saved from smacking them on the side of the drawer. (We all know how comfortable that is!) This saves a ton of space and doesn't look goofy on the wall. My hair dryer fits perfectly in it - and I would think many sizes of dryers would comfortably fit. That's the genius of th

I bought this for my wife because she keeps leaving the hair dryer by the sink and tub. she has a wide end attachment and didn't fit. I use a hack saw and trimmed it.  Now if fits as long as you use a screw motion with dryer to place in holder.  I would give it 5 stars, but my wife still leaves her dryer on the sink. great to modify.  Wish it came with a shocker attachment when you don't put it back into the holster. LOL.  Oh ya, easy to install.

My hairdryer holder has been so handy in keeping my hairdryer off the countertop and in a safe place as it cools. I share my bathroom with my 10-year-old and he's always throwing towels and things down on the vanity without seeing what other hot tools might be on the counter. This stylish little holder is strong, fits all the different hair dryers I've had, and I will take all the help I can get at keeping the vanity safe and cleared off!

reviews.t: Works great, took me a while to get used to ...
reviews.x: Works great, took me a while to get used to the way I was forced to mount it, but this is not the fault of the item.  Available in different configurations so think carefully about where you will place it.  Keeps that dryer or curling iron out of the way.  Mounts securely and always looks nice and shiny.  12/12/19 update:  Still using in the same place years later, looks great and is solidly attached after daily use.

This has to be one of my favorite discoveries!  I purchased this for our bathroom in our house, but am thinking I will need one for our motorhome as well.  It mounted well, and holds my hair dryer perfectly.  Couldn't ask for a better deal.  Love this and will be looking to purchase one this summer before camping season!

This is very sturdy and I mounted it on the inside of my bathroom cabinet, so that my blowdryer is hidden away from view. I actually had my electrician install another outlet inside the cabinet so that the power cables are hidden from view as well.

reviews.t: Doesn't fit short fat nozzled hair dryers.
reviews.x: This product seems extremely sturdy and functional, however the spirals aren't wide enough or long enough for my hairdryer.  Its nozzle is too short and fat so I will have to buy another hair dryer if I want to keep this holder.

It is a handy way to store your hair dryer.  It supposed to installed on a angle but my husband installed it so it's straight up and down(I'm not sure if I really like it that way) but works.  Nice heavy construction.
This is SO practical... it keeps the dryer off the counter and looks cool at the side of our vanity. Everyone who's seen it, comments of how neat it is. It is easy to install, and so far is sturdy.

reviews.t: How did I live without this?!
reviews.x: I love this. Its perfect, it keeps my hair dryer from being thrown over the towel rack or tossed on the floor. It does exactly what its supposed to and everyone who sees it is instantly jealous!!
I no longer have to worry about where to put my hot hair dryer after using it.  This product has held up well with every day use and looks great in our bathroom closet.
i love this product!!!  It mounted easily onto the wall and keeps my blow dryer out of the way when I'm getting ready and is handy for me to grab when I need it

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the holder as sturdy, solid, and well made.
Many customers say it frees up counter or drawer space and keeps the dryer handy and organized.
Several reviewers report the holder is too small for larger hair dryers or those with attachments.
Some customers note confusion or trial and error over choosing the correct left or right mounting orientation.
A few reviewers mention installation ease, though one notes screws were not included and another reports damaged packaging.
